1 حَبَشَ لَهُ , (K,) aor.
حَبُشَ , (TK,) inf. n. حَبْشٌ and حُبَاشَةٌ; (K, TK;) or حَبَشَ لَهُ حُبَاشَةً; (S;) [whence it appears probable that the author of the K is in error in regarding حُبَاشَةٌ as an inf. n.;] He collected for him something; as also ↓ حَبَّشَ , inf. n. تَحْبِيشٌ: (S, K:) and ↓ تحبّشهُ and ↓ احتبشهُ likewise signify he collected it. (TA.) You say also, قَوْمَهُ ↓ حَبَّشَ , inf. n. تَحْبِيشٌ, He collected his people. (S.) And حَبَشَ لِعِيَالِهِ, inf. n. حَبْشٌ, He gained, or earned, and collected, for his family, or household; like هَبَشَ; as also ↓ احتبش . (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
